errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)". Interpreting this as "accumulation capacity" is an unverified assumption not present in the figure's text.
The x-axis range is from 0 to slightly beyond 10^3, not up to 10^10. The tick labels are at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3.
The description omits the names of the data series (Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, ROME) which are provided in the legend.
